hard_gate_labels.semantic_rule_compliance_pass: HG1 SEMANTIC_RULE_COMPLIANCE: every claim declares a frozen semantic_rule and matches the claim_id / independence_group / dimension patterns
hard_gate_labels.provenance_integrity_pass: HG2 PROVENANCE_INTEGRITY: every EXECUTED claim carries identity, timestamps, exit_code, sanitised_digest, artifact_reference and artifact_hash; non-EXECUTED claims carry no executed_provenance
hard_gate_labels.independence_group_isolation_pass: HG3 INDEPENDENCE_GROUP_ISOLATION: every claim has a unique independence_group; reuse across EXECUTED claims requires a shared artifact_hash and is rejected otherwise
hard_gate_labels.artifact_binding_pass: HG4 ARTIFACT_BINDING: source_ref paths are bounded inside runtime-evidence/, schemas/ or scripts/; EXECUTED claims additionally bind to an artifact_hash and reference
hard_gate_labels.worksheet_integrity_pass: HG5 WORKSHEET_INTEGRITY: a worksheet is present with at least one step, completed_at and completed_by; missing or incomplete worksheets block the score
hard_gate_labels.verdict_derivation_bounded_pass: HG6 VERDICT_DERIVATION_BOUNDED: launch dimension never emits GO; diagnostic payloads are sanitised; no score is derived without a complete worksheet
